reassurance.name: Reassurance seeking
reassurance.description: You tend to seek external guarantees to feel safe when anxiety appears.
reassurance.strength: You pay attention to details and value safety.
reassurance.challenge: Learn to trust your ability to handle uncertainty.

search.name: Safety searching
search.description: Searching for answers may relieve anxiety in the moment but maintain the worry cycle.
search.strength: You are curious and seek to understand what happens.
search.challenge: Learn to tolerate uncertainty without immediate answers.

body.name: Body hypervigilance
body.description: You are very aware of body sensations and may interpret them as danger.
body.strength: You have awareness and attention to body signals.
body.challenge: Learn to observe sensations without always seeing them as threats.

perfectionism.name: Perfectionism
perfectionism.description: There is a strong need to do everything correctly and avoid mistakes.
perfectionism.strength: You are dedicated and want to do things well.
perfectionism.challenge: Accept that mistakes and imperfections are part of learning.

avoidance.name: Avoidance
avoidance.description: Avoiding situations may bring immediate relief but reinforce fear in the long term.
avoidance.strength: You try to protect yourself when something feels difficult.
avoidance.challenge: Take small steps even with some discomfort.

rumination.name: Rumination
rumination.description: Your mind becomes stuck analysing problems and possibilities.
rumination.strength: You have strong reflection and analysis skills.
rumination.challenge: Learn to disconnect and return to the present moment.

control.name: Need for control
control.description: There is a constant search to make sure everything goes well.
control.challenge: Accept that some uncertainty is part of life.

comparison.name: Social comparison
comparison.description: Comparing yourself with others can affect how you see your own value.
comparison.strength: You observe and learn from people around you.
